title: 第9章 师父我反对第10章 师兄师弟送你一桩富贵
content_zh:
“师父，你不能这样，许师弟已经搬气了，你还要为难他吗？”
“搬气？三十年搬气，呵呵，明语，不要闹了。”
白苍真人大手一挥，面无表情说道：“你师弟他不是修炼的料，这么多年了，你还看不明白吗？”
“三十年晋升搬气，整个白云派，不，应该说纵观我们白云派千年以来，都没人能超越他，未来一千年，估计也不会有这样的人出现了。”
“为师能够让他在山上留了三十多年，也算是仁至义尽了，他也要下山做任务，是时候为宗门付出了。”
明语师姐反对。
“不行，师弟他才搬气，实力卑微弱小，师父你忍心师弟下山吗？”
“山下纷乱，妖族动荡，其他门派盯着我们白云派，还有诸多散修虎视眈眈，师弟下山肯定会遭遇不测的，师父，你不能这样做。”
白苍真人看着自己的徒弟，有些头痛。
搬气之后，许多弟子都会选择下山，此乃白云派的规矩，也是一种文化。
许多弟子晋升搬气之后，稍微稳重修炼几年，就开始着手为突破纳魂做准备，一味留在山上修炼是无法快速突破的，只有经历了生死关头，才能更快突破。
下山的好处很多，可以历练自己，经历各种情况，突破了，未来，一片坦途。
失败了，就是死亡。
“师父，我不同意。”
白苍真人淡淡说道：“你师弟他晋升搬气也有一段时间了，再不下山，可就废了，明语啊，你莫要闹了。”
“我白苍的弟子，哪一个是贪生怕死之人，三千弟子，都为了真传位置而努力，你师弟他也该如此，而不是留在山上种田养猪，能有什么出息？”
“一辈子就知道种田养猪，我白苍真人不要脸吗？”
他的弟子出了一个奇葩，丢脸啊。
总是被其他的山主嘲笑，也被其他的同道嘲笑。
若是可以，他早就想让许君白下山，哪怕死了，也好过留在宗门种田养猪。

没出息的弟子，自然……
种植灵药不是不重要，可是，不能是他白苍真人的弟子。
这些都是某些炼丹之人做的事情，他们的弟子会去做的，轮不到他们白梧山的弟子去做这种事情，要做，也是那些没有希望的弟子去做。
之前，许君白成为了他的笑话，现如今，他晋升搬气，再也不是那种没希望的弟子，白苍真人不允许许君白继续摆烂。
“为师也是为了你师弟好，明语，你明白为师的苦心吗？”
明语盯着白苍真人。
她咬咬牙。
最后，还是……
“师父，你可要关照师弟一点，那可是你的弟子。”
“放心吧，明语，再怎么说他也是为师的弟子，为父可不会看着他死去。”
老夫弟子多的是，三千弟子，死了几百个，还有很多呢。
搬气境界的弟子，基本上都死了。
多许君白一个不多，少他一个不少。
content_en:
"Master, you can't do this. Junior Brother Xu is already angry. Do you still want to embarrass him?"
"To vent your anger? Thirty years to vent your anger, haha, Mingyu, stop making trouble."
Master Bai Cang waved his hand and said expressionlessly: "Your junior brother is not a cultivation material. After so many years, you still can't understand?"
"After thirty years of promotion, no one in the entire Baiyun Sect, no, it should be said that throughout the thousand years of our Baiyun Sect, has been able to surpass him. In the next thousand years, it is estimated that no such person will appear."
"As a teacher, I allowed him to stay in the mountain for more than thirty years. It is considered to be the most benevolent and righteous. He has to go down to the mountain to complete the task. It is time to pay for the sect."
Senior Sister Mingyu objected.
"No, Junior Brother is just venting his anger. His strength is low and weak. Master, can you bear to have Junior Brother go down the mountain?"
"There is chaos below the mountain, the demon clan is in turmoil, other sects are staring at our Baiyun sect, and there are many casual cultivators who are also eyeing us. Junior brother will definitely encounter something unexpected when he goes down the mountain. Master, you can't do this."
Master Bai Cang looked at his apprentice with a headache.
After removing their qi, many disciples will choose to go down the mountain. This is the rule of Baiyun Sect and it is also a culture.
After many disciples were promoted to Qi and practiced steadily for a few years, they began to prepare for the breakthrough of Nahun. It would not be possible to break through quickly if they just stayed on the mountain to practice. Only after experiencing the critical moment of life and death can they break through faster.
There are many benefits to going down the mountain. You can train yourself, experience various situations, and make breakthroughs. The future will be smooth.
Failure means death.
"Master, I disagree."
Master Bai Cang said calmly: "Your junior brother has been promoted to Qi for some time. If he doesn't come down from the mountain, he will be useless. Mingyu, please don't make trouble."
"Which of my Bai Cang disciples is greedy for life and afraid of death? Three thousand disciples are all working hard for the position of true disciple. Your junior brother should do the same. Instead of staying in the mountains to farm and raise pigs, what future can he have?"
"I have known farming and raising pigs my whole life. Do I, Master Bai Cang, have no shame?"
His disciple did something strange, which was embarrassing.
He is always laughed at by other mountain owners and also ridiculed by other comrades.
If possible, he would have wanted Xu Junbai to come down from the mountain. Even if he died, it would be better than staying in the sect to farm and raise pigs.
A disciple with no future, naturally...
Planting spiritual medicine is not unimportant, but it cannot be his disciple of Master Bai Cang.
These are things that some alchemists do, and their disciples will do them. It is not their turn for the disciples of Baiwu Mountain to do such things. If they do, it will be done by those disciples who have no hope.
Before, Xu Junbai became his joke, but now that he has been promoted to Qi, he is no longer the kind of hopeless disciple. Master Bai Cang will not allow Xu Junbai to continue to act badly.
"Being a teacher is also for the good of your junior brother. Mingyu, do you understand the painstaking efforts of being a teacher?"
Mingyu stared at Master Bai Cang.
She gritted her teeth.
Finally, still...
"Master, you have to take care of your junior brother, he is your disciple."
"Don't worry, Mingyu, no matter what, he is still my master's disciple, and my father will not watch him die."
I have many disciples, three thousand disciples, hundreds of them have died, and there are still many more.
The disciples in the Qi-moving realm are basically dead.
One more Xu Junbai is not more, one less him is not a lot.
